req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first 'skip' items and caps results at 'limit'. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — typical skip+limit returns correct slice; (2) boundary BVA — skip=0,limit=1 (minimum limit per constraint ge=1) returns exactly one item; (3) boundary BVA — limit at its maximum allowed value (1000); (4) negative NEG — skip < 0 returns 422; (5) negative NEG — limit=0 returns 422 (ge=1 constraint); (6) DT — skip beyond total count returns empty list; (7) BVA — limit=1 with skip=N-1 returns exactly the last item. Each test seeds its own data via POST, uses exact-value assertions, and tests both sides of boundary conditions to kill off-by-one and comparison-flip mutations.

tests.name: test_skip_and_limit_typical_slice
expected: HTTP 200
Response body is a list of exactly 2 tasks
Returned tasks are the 3rd and 4th created tasks (index 2 and 3)
trace: R-TASK-005: skip=2 skips first 2; limit=2 caps at 2
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

titles = [f"Task-{i}" for i in range(5)]
for t in titles:
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": t, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201

r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=2")
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.json()
assert len(data) == 2
assert data[0]["title"] == "Task-2"
assert data[1]["title"] == "Task-3"
